annotation.title_clean: European Parliament legislative resolution of 13 March 2024 on the proposal for a regulation laying down harmonised rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.title_en: European Parliament legislative resolution of 13 March 2024 on the proposal for a regulation laying down harmonised rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: Official Journal publication of the European Parliament's first-reading legislative resolution of 13 March 2024 adopting its position on the Artificial Intelligence Act. The position corresponds to the final act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. The excerpt contains only procedural recitals and the title, not the substantive articles.
key_provisions_or_claims: Parliament adopts its first-reading position on the AI Act proposal COM(2021)0206.
Position corresponds to the final act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689.
The act amends several Union regulations and directives, including on vehicles, civil aviation and railways.
The President is instructed to forward the position to the Council, Commission and national parliaments.
